We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences. 

As a part of The Brandtech Group, we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our AI solutions enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results. 

Role: Global Programme Director

Location:  London, United Kingdom (1-3 days a week from our London HQ)

 

THE OPPORTUNITY

OLIVER is growing — and we're building our pipeline of senior programme talent ahead of new account wins across our global network.

We're looking to connect with experienced Global Programme Directors who are open to an early conversation about upcoming opportunities. As we pitch for and win major international accounts, we want to hear from programme leaders who thrive in complex, multi-region environments and have a consistent track record of delivering at scale.

This isn't a specific vacancy. It's an invitation to start a conversation.

Based in London, with a hybrid working pattern (1–3 days in our London offices), these roles sit at the intersection of strategic direction, commercial leadership, and operational excellence. We support flexible working and are open to discussing different arrangements. We offer reasonable adjustments throughout our process.

THE ROLE

Global Programme Directors at OLIVER are the most senior programme voice on their accounts — trusted by clients at executive level and accountable for delivery health, financial performance, and team capability across everything they touch.

You'll lead medium-to-complex, multi-region programmes, bringing together creative, production, technology, and commercial disciplines to deliver transformational outcomes for some of the world's most ambitious brands. You'll drive measurable change within one of the most innovative in-house agency models in the industry — and help shape what programme excellence looks like across OLIVER's global network.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Programme Delivery and Governance

  • Lead medium-to-complex global programmes, maintaining alignment to strategic goals, financial targets, and client expectations throughout
  • Develop and drive programme vision — managing organisational change and delivering integrated outcomes across studios, functions, and geographies
  • Hold full accountability for delivery health: governance, risk management, issue resolution, and stakeholder coordination across concurrent workstreams
  • Establish and track KPIs; produce regular programme status reports covering risks, issues, and performance metrics; implement corrective actions as needed
  • Lead enterprise-scale transformation programmes centred on technology, people, and process — mapping dependencies, managing timelines, and ensuring nothing falls between workstreams

Commercial Leadership

  • Hold full accountability for account gross profit, including all approvals that affect GP: resourcing decisions, freelancers, expenses, and ad hoc cost requirements
  • Build complex scenario plans across multiple brands and regions, modelling the impact of tools, technology, and commercial decisions on programme performance
  • Create and manage Corrective Action Plans to protect GP targets; make strategic adjustments to people and cost base as required
  • Present revenue forecasting and financial performance to COO, SVP, and executive stakeholders; secure business approvals on decisions with financial implications
  • Drive cost efficiency across tightly resourced teams — identifying and implementing appropriate levers without compromising output quality

Technical and Solution Design

  • Develop deep fluency across OLIVER and BTG technology and services, including delivery platforms, automation tools, and AI
  • Lead senior-level client conversations on technical solutions — knowing when to resolve directly and when to bring in specialist expertise
  • Design solutions that integrate commercial thinking, people resources, and technology to meet client needs at scale
  • Partner with the Senior Leadership Team on solution packaging and client proposals

Resource and Team Leadership

  • Oversee resource scheduling and utilisation across account portfolios, ensuring people are deployed efficiently and workloads are balanced across the wider OLIVER network
  • Work with Client Services and Resource Management on pipeline planning to ensure team structure is correctly sized and skilled at each stage of delivery
  • Ensure clear RACI frameworks are in place across all disciplines; confirm reporting lines and accountabilities are understood across the programme
  • Build and develop programme teams — providing leadership, mentoring, and structured feedback that raises capability and performance at every level

WHAT YOU BRING

  • A strong track record of leading global programme delivery across large-scale, multi-studio account portfolios in complex organisational environments.
  • Ideally Advertising/ Marketing industry experience 
  • Deep expertise in programme and project management — including governance, risk management, delivery health, and stakeholder coordination across multiple concurrent workstreams.
  • Advanced commercial acumen — experience managing large-scale budgets with direct accountability for gross profit, revenue forecasting, and financial performance reporting to executive stakeholders.
  • Executive-level client partnership experience — building and sustaining trusted relationships with senior clients, managing escalations, and leading strategic conversations with confidence.
  • Proven ability to lead and develop large, geographically distributed teams — creating accountability, clarity, and high performance across diverse disciplines.
  • Experience leading enterprise-scale transformation programmes centred on technology, people, and process change.
  • Fluency with delivery management platforms and operational tools, including Agile and scrum methodologies. Familiarity with automation and AI platforms is a strong advantage.
  • Ability to design commercially viable solutions that integrate people, technology, and process — and to partner with senior leadership on how those solutions are packaged and communicated to clients.
  • A clear track record of meeting and protecting GP targets across complex, multi-region accounts, including experience presenting financial performance and forecasting to COO and SVP-level stakeholders.

Gen AI and Agentic Thinking

  • Strategic integration of AI and automation across programme delivery and studio operations — identifying where these tools create measurable efficiency and quality gains
  • Experience setting AI governance and quality standards at programme or studio level, ensuring responsible and effective adoption across teams
  • Track record of developing AI capability across multiple teams and disciplines, embedding new ways of working into programme operations and client delivery
  • Agentic leadership for complex, multi-stakeholder business challenges — systematic and goal-oriented in approach to problem-solving at scale
  • Thought leadership on AI's evolving role in agency operations, contributing to best practice internally and with clients

Commercial and Budget Skills

  • Experience managing programme-level budgets at significant scale, with accountability for gross profit, scenario planning, corrective action planning, and strategic cost management
  • Confidence presenting budget performance and financial forecasting to senior and executive stakeholders

Qualifications: Formal qualifications are welcome but not required. Equivalent experience counts — gained through work, study, or professional development.

If you're excited about where OLIVER is heading and don't meet every point above, we still encourage you to get in touch.

Our values shape everything we do: 

Be Ambitious to succeed   

Be Imaginative to push the boundaries of what's possible   

Be Inspirational to do groundbreaking work   

Be always learning and listening to understand   

Be Results-focused  to exceed expectations   

Be actively pro-inclusive and anti-racist across our community, clients and creations

title: Senior Partner Marketing Manager - EMEA
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Fastly helps people stay better connected with the things they love. Fastly’s edge cloud platform enables customers to create great digital experiences quickly, securely, and reliably by processing, serving, and securing our customers’ applications as close to their end-users as possible — at the edge of the Internet. The platform is designed to take advantage of the modern internet, to be programmable, and to support agile software development. Fastly’s customers include many of the world’s most prominent companies, including GitHub, Yelp, Paramount, and JetBlue.</p> <p>We're building a more trustworthy Internet. Come join us.</p></div><p><strong>Senior Partner Marketing Manager, EMEA&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Come join the team that’s building our partners’ growth engine. Right now, we are executing a critical strategic transition from a legacy direct-led approach to one made up of high-velocity, specialized ecosystem partners. As the Senior Regional Partner Marketing Manager, you are not here to distribute brochures, manage a portal graveyard, or chase passive deal registrations. You are an Ecosystem Growth Architect.&nbsp;</p> <p>Based in London and reporting directly to the Director of Global Partner Marketing (US-based), your mission is to treat co-marketing as an economic multiplier, laser-targeting premium MSSPs, security VARs, and GSIs across our priority regional territories while showing them how to become a high-margin services business using Fastly.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What You'll Do:</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Drive Pipeline Through/With Partners: Drive incremental, high-intent pipeline coverage across targeted EMEA market segments to directly address regional pipeline deficits, working closely with both Channel Account Managers and Territory Sales.&nbsp;</p> </li> <li> <p>Activate the Partner Demand-gen Engine: Act as the regional demand-generation subject matter expert, architecting and launching end-to-end partner marketing campaigns that activate the ecosystem co-marketing flywheel.</p> </li> <li> <p>Market the Services Revenue Multiplier: Demonstrate to partners how Fastly can serve as the engine for their own high-margin services business through GTM value proposition and high-impact joint marketing engagements.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> </li> <li> <p>Localize &amp; Scale Channel Programs: Master our partner program framework to seamlessly adapt global marketing initiatives for the unique nuances of the EMEA market, while also originating net-new regional programs with the blueprint to scale globally.</p> </li> <li> <p>Act as a High-Agency Owner: Bring a proactive, builder-marketer mindset to this foundational role, with the autonomy to shape our EMEA partner marketing framework and adapt strategies as our regional footprint grows.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>What We're Looking For</strong></p> <p><strong><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Basic Qualifications</span></strong>:</p> <ul> <li> <p>8+ years of B2B technology marketing experience, with a minimum of 4 years dedicated specifically to channel, distributor, or partner ecosystem marketing within the SaaS, cloud infrastructure, or cyber-security sectors.</p> </li> <li> <p>Proven experience collaborating with specialized two-tier distribution frameworks or premier security VARs and GSIs across EMEA.</p> </li> <li> <p>Demonstrated success building and executing co-marketing frameworks that drive measurable enterprise pipeline growth.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong written and verbal communication skills; based in London with a track record of successfully working across global, distributed cross-functional teams.</p> </li> <li> <p>You have an interest in independently and proactively running multiple projects in a dynamic environment using superior project management skills&nbsp;</p> </li> <li> <p>You have knowledge of specific regional considerations in EMEA, including knowledge about sub-regional differences and nuances, and can supply strategic input across both global and regional teams</p> </li> <li> <p>Fluency in a second European language (particularly French) is highly advantageous.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Work Location(s) &amp; Travel Requirements</strong></p> <div> <p>This position is based out of Fastly’s London, UK office.&nbsp; Fastly currently embraces a largely hybrid model for most roles which allows employees flexibility to split their time between the office and home.&nbsp;</p> <p>This position may require travel as required by your role or requested by your manager.</p> </div> <p><strong>Work Hours:</strong> This position will require you to be available during core business hours 9:00-18:00 with some flexibility due to timezones.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>We care about you. Fastly works hard to create a positive environment for our employees, and we think your life outside of work is important too. We support our teams with great benefits that start on the first day of your employment with Fastly. Curious about our offerings?</p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Why Fastly?</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p><strong>We have a huge impact.</strong>&nbsp;Fastly is a small company with a big reach. Not only do<a class="external-link" href="https://www.fastly.com/customers" target="_blank">&nbsp;our customers</a>&nbsp;have a tremendous user base, but we also support a growing number of<a class="external-link" href="https://www.fastly.com/open-source/" target="_blank">&nbsp;open source projects and initiatives</a>.&nbsp;Outside of code, employees are encouraged to share causes close to their heart with others so we can help lend a supportive hand.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>We value diversity.</strong>&nbsp;Growing and maintaining our inclusive and diverse team matters to us. We are committed to being a company where our employees feel comfortable bringing their authentic selves to work and have the ability to be successful -- every day.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>We are passionate.</strong>&nbsp;Fastly is chock full of passionate people and we’re not ‘one size fits all’. Fastly employs authors, pilots, skiers, parents (of humans and animals), makeup geeks, coffee connoisseurs, and more. We love employees for who they are and what they are passionate about.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>We’re always looking for humble, sharp, and creative folks to join the Fastly team. If you think you might be a fit please apply!</strong><strong> A fully completed application and resume or CV are required when applying.</strong></p> <p><em>All job applications must be submitted through our official careers site at </em><a href="http://www.fastly.com/careers"><em>www.fastly.com/about/careers</em></a><em>. We will never request sensitive information, such as your Social Security number, bank account or credit card information during the application process. All official communication will come from an @</em><a href="http://fastly.com"><em>fastly.com</em></a><em> or @</em><a href="http://recruiting.fastly.com"><em>recruiting.fastly.com</em></a><em> email address. </em></p> <p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">Fastly is committed to ensuring equal employment opportunity and to providing employees with a safe and welcoming work environment free of discrimination and harassment. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact your Recruiter, or the Fastly Employee Relations team at </span></em><a ----- style="font-weight: ----- style="font-weight: 400;"> or 501-287-4901.&nbsp; </span></em></p> <p><em>Fastly collects and processes personal data submitted by job applicants in accordance with our<a class="external-link" href="https://www.fastly.com/privacy" target="_blank">&nbsp;Privacy Policy</a>. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Optimove, we believe people are capable of more than a single job description. You’re not hired just to fill a position- you’re empowered to shape it, grow it, and make it your own.<br>We call this being Positionless.<br>And Positionless isn’t just our culture. It’s our product.<br>Optimove is the creator of Positionless Marketing, an AI-powered platform that gives every marketer the power to analyze, create, launch, and optimize independently. The result is faster execution, deeper personalization, and 88% greater campaign efficiency.<br>Recognized as a Visionary in Gartner’s Magic Quadrant, we partner with leading brands like Sephora, Staples, and Entain. Today, more than 500 Optimovers across NYC, London, Tel Aviv, Scotland, Brazil, Estonia, and beyond are building the future of marketing together, in an environment that actively encourages ownership and growth, with two out of every three managers promoted from within.<br>If you’re looking for a place where you can do more, be more, come grow with us.</p></div><p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>As a Machine Learning Engineer, you'll join our Personalize team, helping shape and build the products that let our customers personalise messages across every digital touchpoint. You'll work with text data and with cutting-edge technologies including Large Language Models (LLMs), bringing Accessible Intelligence to our customers across both Personalize and Optimove's overall platforms.</p> <p>This is a role for an engineer who's ready to own meaningful, medium-sized pieces of our personalisation roadmap end-to-end - from problem framing through to deployment and monitoring - and trusted to do so with minimal oversight. It's not solo delivery: you'll be working closely with a dynamic team spanning ML, MLOps and software engineering, and should be happy to contribute at every level, from early-stage research through to production support.</p> <p><strong>Role &amp; Core Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the delivery of medium-sized ML features end-to-end within Personalize - problem framing, data preparation, model build/train, evaluation, deployment and monitoring - to predictable timelines.</li> <li>Develop predictive ML models for classification, ranking and personalisation, working with our text data.</li> <li>Leverage LLMs and other state-of-the-art techniques to enhance product capabilities.</li> <li>Operationalise models as APIs across real-time and batch environments.</li> <li>Monitor production models in your own scope, treating data quality issues and model degradation as a priority.</li> <li>Research new ML applications and improve pre-existing models, sharing findings with the wider ML, MLOps and engineering team.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with product, MLOps and engineering teams to define and prepare new ML applications, contributing meaningfully to planning and grooming.</li> <li>Proactively surface and resolve technical and data challenges before they affect delivery, model quality or customers.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Best Bits of the Job</strong></p> <ul> <li>Exposure to a wide range of ML domains, including large-scale search, ranking, Natural Language Processing, hybridisation, classification and text data processing.</li> <li>Working with modern ML technologies, including LLMs, to enhance our products.</li> <li>Fully real-time architecture for data processing, model development and deployment.</li> <li>Deploying and enhancing ML frameworks, optimising for inference and training/retraining cycles.</li> <li>Online testing of models with live data, using our proprietary A/B/N testing technology to see quickly what performs well.</li> <li>A supportive, collaborative team spanning ML, MLOps and software engineering, where rapid experimentation is the norm.</li> <li>Dedicated time to research new methods, build proofs-of-concept, and ship to production quickly when they work.</li> <li>Everyday use of modern AI coding assistants (e.g. Claude) to speed up experimentation and review.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Essential Requirements</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics or a related field, <strong>OR</strong> 1–4 years' professional experience building and deploying ML models.</li> <li>Strong understanding of core ML concepts - supervised/unsupervised learning, model evaluation, feature engineering - and broad familiarity with common algorithms and architectures.</li> <li>Strong Python (pandas, NumPy, etc.) and SQL skills</li> <li>Comfortable with the standard ML toolkit: Git, Docker, scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow, and ML pipelines.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with text data and relevant Natural Language Processing techniques.</li> <li>Solid experience with cloud technologies and data storage solutions, including Snowflake.</li> <li>Everyday use of AI coding assistants (e.g. Claude), and a basic understanding of responsible AI practices - data privacy, bias/fairness and explainability.</li> <li>Must be eligible to work in the UK – we are unable to provide sponsorship at this time</li> <li>This is a Hybrid role, and you will be required in our Dundee office two days per week.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable Requirements</strong></p> <ul> <li>Understanding of personalisation across domains such as sports betting and gaming, and what best practice looks like there.</li> <li>Full understanding of recommendation algorithms and their applications.</li> <li>Professional experience in personalisation and/or predictive CRM, and micro-segmentation.</li> <li>Experience with CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools (Terraform, Bicep, etc.).</li> </ul> <p><strong>Growth &amp; Progression</strong></p> <p>This role sits on the in-role path towards Senior Machine Learning Engineer. As you grow, you'll deepen your expertise in our core ML stack, take on end-to-end ownership of larger features, represent the team in cross-functional planning with MLOps and software engineering.</p> <p><strong>Working at Optimove</strong></p> <p>Optimove offers a vibrant, people‑first culture where innovation, ownership, and continuous learning shape everything we do. Our UK team enjoys a modern office with a hybrid work model, daily lunch budget when onsite, and a fully stocked kitchen, along with a wide range of social events throughout the year. We’re committed to helping our people grow in an inclusive, supportive workplace recognised as one of the UK’s Best Workplaces in Tech and for Wellbeing.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Optimove is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants fairly, without regard to race, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. If you require any adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.<br><br><br>By submitting this application, you agree that Optimove will process your personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws, including GDPR. For details, see our <a href="https://www.optimove.com/legal/privacy-policy" target="_blank">Privacy Policy</a>.</p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

As Principal Data Scientist, you will be a technical authority for CoMind's data science function, setting methodological direction for signal condition and extraction, personally driving the most complex and highest-impact problems, and providing expert guidance on data science best practice across the team. Own signal processing and analysis programmes from research through to validated, production-quality implementations with Software Engineering. Derive achievable performance bounds from instrument and noise models, and use them to drive algorithm selection, requirement setting and design trade-offs Own how the team handles uncertainty and calibration — inference methods appropriate to small clinical cohorts, per-patient estimation with quantified uncertainty, and calibration strategies that make measurements comparable across devices, sessions and patients. Identify and introduce new, best-practice methods from estimation, inference and measurement science in adjacent fields. Act as a mentor to members of the Data Science teams and across the wider business Contribute to CoMind's IP and publication strategy, authoring and reviewing technical papers, patent applications and regulatory documents. In joining us, you will be helping to create cutting-edge technologies that will improve how we diagnose and treat brain disorders, ultimately improving and saving the lives of patients across the world.

The Role

The Data Science team at CoMind develops the algorithms and machine learning systems that transform raw optical interference signals from CoMind One into continuous, clinically meaningful measurements of cerebral blood flow, intracranial pressure, and autoregulation. Working at the frontier of photonics, physiology, and applied ML, the team's work directly determines what CoMind One can measure, how accurately, and under what clinical conditions.

As Principal Data Scientist, you will be a technical authority for CoMind's data science function, setting methodological direction for signal condition and extraction, personally driving the most complex and highest-impact problems, and providing expert guidance on data science best practice across the team. This is a senior individual contributor role: you will not manage people directly, but your technical leadership will shape how the entire team approaches its most challenging problems. You will work closely with R&D, Clinical, and Software Engineering.

At CoMind, all team members work at least 4 days per week from our new Kings Cross offices, plus a flexible work-from-home day.

Responsibilities:

  • Act as the technical authority for the end-to-end signal processing and inference chain for CoMind’s technologies: from raw optical data through to clinical measurements

  • Set the methodological direction for estimation, signal extraction and ML modelling across the team: which approaches suit which problems, how they are evaluated, and what evidence is required before a method is trusted.

  • Own signal processing and analysis programmes from research through to validated, production-quality implementations with Software Engineering.

  • Derive achievable performance bounds from instrument and noise models, and use them to drive algorithm selection, requirement setting and design trade-offs

  • Own how the team handles uncertainty and calibration — inference methods appropriate to small clinical cohorts, per-patient estimation with quantified uncertainty, and calibration strategies that make measurements comparable across devices, sessions and patients.

  • Set the standard for how the data science function works: reproducibility, analysis and code review, experiment design, dataset governance and ground-truth definitions

  • Act as the primary technical reviewer and expert resource across the research organisation, reviewing technical reports, analysis plans and evaluation methodology, and holding the bar for methodological rigour and scientific integrity.

  • Identify and introduce new, best-practice methods from estimation, inference and measurement science in adjacent fields.

  • Act as a mentor to members of the Data Science teams and across the wider business

  • Contribute to CoMind's IP and publication strategy, authoring and reviewing technical papers, patent applications and regulatory documents.

AI is fundamental to our culture. It's not just a tool, but a core part of how we work, collaborate, and innovate. We expect all team members to embrace AI in their daily work and continuously find new ways to use it effectively.

Skills & Experience:

  • 15+ years of experience in data science, ML, or applied research, with a strong track record of independent technical leadership on complex, ambiguous problems

  • A career working to extract small signals from noisy, complex physiological systems, and developing and deploying physical models of those systems to support those efforts.

  • Deep expertise in physiological time-series signal processing methodologies.

  • A demonstrated ability to take algorithmic work from research concept through to production-quality, validated implementations in shipped product.

  • Designing device performance evaluation methods where no prior gold-standard exists: simulating physical systems, running sensitivity analysis, identifying failure modes, and developing signal processing solutions to address those challenges.

  • Extensive experience owning calibration and cross-instrument comparability work that involved noise models, error budgets, and evaluation of experimental data

  • Strong record of scientific output: publications, patents, or equivalent evidence of original technical contribution and domain authority

Nice to Have:

  • Background in neuroscience, neuromonitoring, or cerebrovascular physiology

  • Experience with optical signal processing - e.g. LiDAR, pulse oximetry, NIRS, laser doppler flowmetry, or related technologies

  • Experience in a regulated industry (medical devices, diagnostics, pharma, or similar), with familiarity of algorithm validation and documentation requirements for software as a medical device

Benefits:

  • Company equity plan so all employees share in the success of the company

  • Salary-sacrifice pension scheme

  • Private medical, dental and vision insurance (medical history disregarded)

  • Group life assurance at 4x annual income

  • Comprehensive mental health support, including unlimited access to 1:1 sessions with trained professionals

  • Unlimited holiday allowance (+ bank holidays) and one week of remote working per quarter

  • Lunch voucher (£10) every day for JustEat and free dinner on those days where you need to work later

  • Twice weekly deliveries of fresh fruit and an extensive selection of snacks and drinks

  • YuLife subscription, allowing you to turn your daily steps and meditation into discounts at a range of stores

  • Access to Udemy for upskilling and professional development

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: We pull medical technology from the future to solve human health. Scarlet is authorised to assess and certify medical devices. We combine clinical, technical and regulatory expertise with AI agents and software so rigorous certification can keep pace with product development at the world’s most ambitious technology companies, without lowering the safety bar. Our customers have cut a year or more from their certification timelines for new AI-enabled medical devices and shortened product-update cycles from months to weeks. You’ll join a team building the infrastructure that makes these outcomes repeatable at scale. About the role The Applied Machine Learning team owns production systems and pursues new ideas, from conception and prototyping through to deployment, evaluation and iterative improvement. Working with clinicians, assessors and engineers, we build reliable ML systems that help bring medical devices to market faster, without compromising safety. It’s a domain rich in text, data and expert judgment, with little precedent for much of what we’re building. You’ll own meaningful problems in how we assess medical devices: define success with domain experts, decide what to build and test, and take ML systems through deployment and measurable improvement in production. Responsibilities Things you might work on: Agentic document understanding – Build agents that search, parse and visually inspect messy technical files: scanned certificates, tables, architecture diagrams and thousands of pages of evidence. Find what matters and show exactly where it came from. Harnesses built for evidence – Develop custom agent harnesses for retrieving information across large document collections in varied formats. Preserve source attribution, minimise hallucination, and make deliberate trade-offs between accuracy, latency and cost. Deploy to production. Evals wired into real workflows – Define success with assessors and build datasets and benchmarks that capture a complex, nuanced domain. Measure retrieval quality, citation correctness and agreement with expert judgment alongside the impact on assessor effort, assessment quality and customer experience, including rework. Use the results to choose what to improve next. Applied AI alignment – Build useful agents that respect the impartiality and objectivity required of a certification body. Help people understand the evidence, recognise uncertainty and retain responsibility for consequential judgments. Who you are Creator of datasets – You roll up your sleeves and build the dataset you wish existed, rather than wait for someone else to give you one. Establisher of evals – You think from first principles about statistics and evaluating ML systems. You're suspicious of benchmarks that don't match reality. Builder of agent systems – You understand deep-learning, agent tools, context management and information retrieval, and how they interact. Shipper of software – 3+ years shipping software to production. You own deployment, monitoring and the investigation when something breaks. Security judgment – You’ve made and implemented pragmatic security decisions for production systems. You can reason about data access, permissions, untrusted inputs and actions with real consequences; design proportionate mitigations; and recognise when specialist review is needed. Systems design – You’ve designed, deployed and operated production systems. You can choose infrastructure that fits the workload, explain the trade-offs in complexity, reliability, security and cost, and work within shared engineering standards. Hacker – You take ambitious projects from concept to reality with whatever tools are at hand. You experiment, measure and change your mind. Builder – You're insatiably curious about real-world problems and care that what you build has clear economic and human value. Owner of ambiguous problems – You can point to an ambiguous problem you owned: working directly with domain experts to define success, choosing what to try, and following it through experiments and production to measurable improvement. Preferred qualifications Experience deploying agent systems with tool use, sensitive data or consequential actions, including evaluating their behaviour and designing safeguards. Experience building retrieval or document-understanding systems whose outputs must be checked against complex source evidence. Interview process Intro call with Alan – 30 mins Technical interview – 60 mins Working session in our London office with Alan and Jamie – 90 mins Culture and values interviews with James and Jamie – 2 × 30 mins Compensation: £90K – £150K • Offers Equity • £90K – £150K • Offers Equity Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

raw.description:

***As this position in based in England, the job description is available in English only.***
 
_________________________________________________
Director of Communications – International Shows (Touring & Resident)
Sales, Marketing and Communications
Full-Time Position


Reports to: Reports to Vice President - Commercial, Europe, Middle East and Asia with a functional reporting line to SVP, Communication

Scope: All international shows outside the Americas (Europe, UK, Middle East, Africa, Asia-Pacific & Oceania) + Public Affairs
 
Teams: Touring show PR teams (embedded on tour) + Resident show PR teams, and their respective agency rosters
 
 
Role Purpose
 
The Director of Communications – International Shows (Touring & Resident) is responsible for driving demand, building anticipation, and ensuring cultural relevance for Cirque du Soleil’s shows across all markets outside the Americas.
 
This role elevates show communications into a strategic growth engine, integrating PR, earned media, and public affairs to create urgency, unlock market opportunities, and support commercial performance across every international production.
 
Based in London, this role acts as the central show communications and public affairs lead for international markets, ensuring alignment between show storytelling, market-level marketing plans, and cross-functional execution across multiple time zones, languages, and regulatory environments.
 
 
Core Mission
  • Drive anticipation, urgency, and sustained demand for international touring and resident shows
  • Make communications a core lever of the show marketing mix, fully integrated with paid, CRM, and ticketing
  • Lead, develop, and set standards for the touring and resident show PR teams and the agencies that support them
  • Own the strategy and governance of show-specific social media channels as an earned and owned demand driver
  • Leverage public affairs as a growth enabler to unlock market access, market entry, and partnerships
  • Ensure communications is a core driver of ticket revenue and brand equity outside the Americas
  • Orchestrate cross-functional alignment to deliver cohesive show launches across diverse international markets
Key Responsibilities
 
1. Show Communications Strategy – International Touring, Resident Shows & Public Affairs
  • Lead and oversee an international show communications strategy spanning touring productions, resident shows, and public affairs
  • Embed communications within the end-to-end demand engine (onsale → launch → sustain), in lockstep with market marketing plans
  • Integrate public affairs into market entry and growth strategies for new territories
  • Lead communications strategy in support of sponsorships and business development, including building relationships with key stakeholders, and developing joint communication plans with partners
2. Show Communications Leadership (Europe, UK, Middle East, Africa, APAC & Oceania)
  • Own communications strategy and performance across all international touring and resident productions
  • Ensure each show delivers:
    • Clear, differentiated narrative
    • Strong local and cultural relevance, adapted per market and language
    • Full lifecycle comms (pre-onsale → launch → sustain)
  • Implement standards, playbooks, and governance that scale across markets and local agency partners
  • Act as spokesperson for international shows and manage show-level issues in market, escalating to corporate communications at HQ where required
3. Show-Specific Social Media Ownership
  • Ensure each show PR team owns the strategy, management, and community engagement for its show-specific social media channels
  • Set the content, tone, and publishing standards that keep show channels distinctive while consistent with the masterbrand
  • Align show channel activity to the onsale, launch, and sustain calendar in each market
  • Drive creator, influencer, and talent-led content through show channels to build cultural relevance and organic reach
  • Set and track channel performance measures (growth, engagement, referral to ticketing) alongside earned media KPIs
  • Ensure coordination with central brand and social teams on shared assets, escalation paths, and community management protocols
4. Public Affairs & Stakeholder Engagement
  • Leverage public affairs as a strategic growth enabler by building relationships with:
    • Government and public sector stakeholders across international markets
    • Tourism boards, city partners, venues, and cultural institutions
  • Unlock opportunities to:
    • Support market entry for touring and resident shows
    • Facilitate partnerships and local integration
    • Strengthen Cirque du Soleil’s institutional influence outside the Americas
  • Coordinate closely with internal stakeholders to align on regulatory, reputational, and market access considerations, including visas, work permits, and cross-border touring requirements
5. Cross-Functional Orchestration
  • Own coordination across non-marketing functions to ensure aligned execution and messaging around shows, including:
    • Legal
    • HR (incl. talent mobility, immigration)
    • Sustainability
    • Operations
    • Sponsorship & partnerships
  • Act as the central orchestrator ensuring communications supports and amplifies show and market decisions
  • Ensure consistency between internal decisions, external messaging, and market execution, and act as the two-way bridge between international markets and HQ
6. Cultural Relevance & Media Impact
  • Position Cirque du Soleil’s shows as culturally relevant and premium in international markets
  • Build relationships with Tier 1 media, creators, and influencers across the UK, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific
  • Activate cultural moments and partnerships tied to international show launches and runs
7. Team Leadership, Agency Governance & Performance
  • Lead and develop the PR teams embedded with the touring shows and the PR teams responsible for the resident shows, across multiple markets, time zones, and languages
  • Build a consistent operating model, capability plan, and career path across both team groups, including onboarding for new tours and openings
  • Approve and sign off on all agency appointments, scopes, and budgets proposed by the touring and resident show PR teams
  • Define and manage the international agency ecosystem, setting selection criteria, performance standards, and review cadence
  • Set KPIs tied to business impact (demand, awareness, launch momentum, ticket sales, social channel performance)
  • Partner with marketing and analytics to link comms and social to revenue outcomes
Profile & Experience
 
Required
  • 10+ years in communications/PR with multi-market, international leadership experience
  • Proven ability to operate communications as a growth and demand lever tied to sales outcomes
  • Strong experience in consumer, brand, or entertainment PR, ideally with campaign or launch ownership
  • Experience working with government or public sector stakeholders in international markets
  • Deep media relationships across the UK and Europe, with demonstrated reach into additional international markets
  • Experience directly leading distributed, multi-time-zone in-house teams, including teams embedded with touring operations
  • Proven track record appointing, contracting, and managing PR agencies across multiple markets
  • Strong command of organic social media strategy and community management for consumer or entertainment brands
  • Ability to operate in a matrixed, cross-functional environment with a North America–based headquarters
  • Fluent in English (mandatory); willingness to travel frequently across international markets
Preferred
  • Additional language(s) relevant to key international markets (e.g. French, Spanish, German, Arabic, Japanese, Mandarin)
  • Experience in entertainment, touring productions, live events, or premium brands
  • Strong understanding of how communications integrates with marketing, CRM, and revenue generation

title: Senior Data Scientist, Payment Intelligence
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>About us</strong></h3> <p>GoCardless, a Mollie company, is a global leader in bank payments. Over 100,000 businesses, from start-ups to household names, use GoCardless to collect, manage and send bank payments through Direct Debit, real-time payments and open banking. With US$130bn+ processed annually across 30+ countries, we handle recurring and one-off payments without the chasing, stress, or expensive fees. Our end-to-end payment platform also features AI-powered solutions to improve payment success and reduce fraud, alongside connections to over 350 platforms businesses use everyday.<br><br>We are headquartered in the UK, with teams and operations spanning North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific.&nbsp; For more information, please visit<span><a href="http://www.gocardless.com" target="_blank"> www.gocardless.com</a></span> and follow us on LinkedIn<span><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/gocardless" target="_blank"> ----- is the leading payments and financial services partner for business, rooted in Europe, with global reach.</p></div><h3>The role</h3> <p>Data sits at the core of our mission. We leverage bank account data to deliver high-value, intelligent payment solutions for our customers, from enhancing payment success rates to driving payer fraud prevention.</p> <p>As a Senior Data Scientist within our Payment Intelligence team, you’ll partner with Software Engineers, Product Managers, and Designers to turn big ideas into reality. You’ll own the full lifecycle of our algorithms, shaping everything from the initial concept to production-ready code that powers our global payment network.</p> <p>At GoCardless, our stack is centered around Google Cloud Platform and Vertex AI, providing a high-performance environment for innovation. Our Data Scientists operate at the intersection of Python, SQL, and BigQuery to build and deploy high-performance models at scale.</p> <h3><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Lead the end-to-end delivery of models at scale, from initial discovery and feature engineering to production, A/B testing and continuous monitoring.</li> <li>Collaborate with product and engineering peers to turn complex data into real-time, mission-critical fraud prevention solutions.</li> <li>Raise the team’s collective bar through hands-on technical leadership and knowledge sharing.</li> <li>Proactively research and integrate latest developments in ML and payer fraud prevention to drive innovation at GoCardless.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What excites you</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Being a self-starter who thrives on taking a vague business problem and owning the journey from the first prototype to a live, measurable solution.</li> <li>An opportunity to introduce and scale advanced architectures to solve high-stakes fraud and payment challenges.</li> <li>Moving beyond execution to help define the technical roadmap for Payer Fraud Prevention, ensuring we leverage the best tools for the job.</li> <li>Building production-grade ML models on a streamlined GCP and Vertex AI stack to drive fintech innovation.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What excites us</strong></h3> <ul> <li>You hold a degree (or PhD) in a STEM discipline or an equivalent commercial experience.</li> <li>You bring hands-on experience with sophisticated architectures, such as deep learning, graph-based, or sequence-based models (experience in Fintech, Fraud Prevention, or Payments is a big plus).</li> <li>You can translate complex ML concepts into practical product solutions and communicate these ideas clearly to non-technical peers.</li> <li>You are comfortable owning the full lifecycle, from deep-dive analysis and feature engineering to prototyping, validation, and live A/B testing.</li> <li>You lead by example, writing clean, high-quality code and raising the team’s technical bar through knowledge sharing and code best practices.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Base salary range:</strong> £99,200 - £148,800</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Base salary ranges are based on role, job level, location, and market data.&nbsp; Please note that whilst we strive to offer competitive compensation, our approach is to pay between the <span style="text-decoration: underline;">minimum and the mid-point</span> of the pay range until performance can be assessed in role. Offers will take into account level of experience, interview assessment, budgets and parity between you and fellow employees at GoCardless doing similar work.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong>(some of) The good stuff</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Wellbeing </strong>- stay healthy with dedicated support and medical cover</li> <li><strong>Work away scheme</strong> - gives you the option to work away from your country of residence for up to 90 days in any 12 month period</li> <li><strong>Adaptive Working</strong> - allows you to work flexibly, around your lifestyle</li> <li><strong>Parental leave</strong> - to suit everyone embarking on life's great adventure</li> <li><strong>Learning Budget</strong> - lead your own development with an annual learning budget</li> <li><strong>Time off</strong> - generous holiday allowance, + 3 annual volunteer days, + 4 annual business-wide wellness days (‘GC Fridays’)</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Life at GoCardless&nbsp;&nbsp;</strong></h3> <p>We're an organisation defined by our&nbsp;<a href="https://gocardless.com/g/values-operating-principles/">values</a>; We <em>start with why </em>before we begin any project, to ensure it’s aligned with our mission. We<em> act with integrity</em>, always. We <em>care deeply</em> about what we do and we know it's essential that we <em>be humble </em>whilst we do it. Working this way creates the GC magic- the reason we all love showing up to work.&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>Diversity &amp; Inclusion</strong></h3> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">As of April 2025, we had 806 employees (GeeCees) globally, with 524 based in the UK, 163 based in Latvia and 119 across our other offices.</p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">To ensure that we're representative of the world around us - and to be able to review relevant benchmarks - we ask GeeCees to voluntarily disclose diversity data. This year, the proportion of GeeCees providing data increased to 88% (up from 79% in 2024). With regards to diversity within GoCardless, we can see GeeCees identifying as:</p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">Asian, Black, Mixed or Other — <strong>25%</strong>&nbsp;</p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">Neurodiverse — <strong>9%</strong>&nbsp;</p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">LGBTQIA+ — <strong>9%</strong>&nbsp;</p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">Disabled — <strong>1%</strong>&nbsp;</p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">Average age — <strong>33</strong></p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">Female — <strong>45%</strong></p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">Male —&nbsp;<strong> 55%&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>We’re rooting for you during your application and GoCardless aims to provide reasonable adjustments to make our recruitment process as remarkable and accessible as we can. Please speak to your Talent Partner if you need extra support.</p> <p>If you want to learn more, you can read about our Employee Resource Groups and objectives <u><a href="https://www.google.com/url?q=https://gocardless.com/about/careers/&amp;sa=D&amp;source=calendar&amp;ust=1781014616204220&amp;usg=AOvVaw1DeqgyeRfEwEzecwn4oq3j" target="_blank">here</a></u><br><br><strong>Sustainability</strong><br><br>We’re committed to reducing our impact on the environment, leaving a more sustainable world for future generations. Check out our sustainability <a href="https://gocardless.com/sustainability"><u>action plan</u> </a>here.</p> <p>Find out more about Life at GoCardless via <a href="http://twitter.com/GoCardlessEng">Twitter</a>, <a href="http://instagram.com/lifeatgocardless">Instagram</a> and <a href="http://linkedin.com/company/gocardless">LinkedIn</a>.&nbsp;</p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Software Engineer, Agentic AI
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif; color: #662d91;">Teamwork makes the stream work.</h2> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>Roku is changing how the world watches TV</strong></h3> <p>Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.</p> <p>From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div><p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>What does the team work on?</strong></h3> <p><br>At Roku, the Device Monetization and Themed Experiences (DMTE) team, a part of the Advertising organization, is where the magic behind the scenes happens. We're the engineers who build the high-performance graphics and UI foundations that power the AD Display — the core technology enabling Roku's smooth, responsive, and visually rich experiences on millions of devices worldwide. Our work lives in the middleware and UI layers, and its impact is felt every time a user navigates a menu, enjoys an animated ad, or is wowed by the bespoke experience built to market the latest TV show or Movies. We thrive on solving the toughest technical challenges — from optimizing UI rendering to fine-tuning memory usage — using BrightScript (a JavaScript-like language) to deliver rock-solid, high-performance solutions. We work in a collaborative, high-trust environment where great ideas can come from anywhere, partnering closely with firmware, UI, and product teams to ensure our platform is lightning fast, reliable, and ready for the next generation of streaming innovation. If you love building the invisible foundations that make great user experiences possible, this is the team for you.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><br><strong>What is the role?</strong></h3> <div><br>As a Senior Agentic AI Engineer in the DMTE team, you'll be the driving force behind embedding intelligent, autonomous AI capabilities into Roku's platform — reimagining how our systems create, optimize, and deliver experiences to tens of millions of devices. Rather than building UI features directly, you'll design and deploy agentic AI systems that reason, plan, and act across our development and delivery pipelines — from automating the generation of themed experiences to enabling self-optimizing rendering workflows within the AD Display. You'll leverage your years of experience in software engineering and building world class UI to build AI agents that understand the constraints of embedded, performance-critical systems and operate effectively within them. This is a role for engineers who think in terms of autonomous systems, multi-step reasoning, and tool-use architectures — and who want to fundamentally reshape how a streaming platform is built, maintained, and evolved.</div> <div> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>How will I use AI at Roku?</strong></h3> <p>At Roku, we don’t just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We’re looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they’ve used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact.&nbsp;<br>We value your AI skills if have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> </div> <h3><br><strong>What are the responsibilities of the role?</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Apply strong software engineering principles to design, build, and ship reliable, performant systems at scale</li> <li>Bring rigorous software engineering practices — clean architecture, testing, code review - to building systems that are reliable and performant at scale</li> <li>Apply sound software engineering fundamentals (system design, testing, code review) to ship reliable, performant systems at scale</li> <li>We don't train models, we don't 'fine-tune' LLMs; We build automated agentic processes</li> <li>Design, build, and deploy agentic AI systems that autonomously generate, test, and optimize BrightScript/TypeScript code and UI experiences for the FRAME engine</li> <li>Architect multi-agent workflows (planning, tool-use, retrieval, execution, validation) that accelerate development and reduce manual engineering effort across the team</li> <li>Develop AI-powered automation that understands the constraints of embedded C++ environments and produces performance-safe, memory-efficient outputs</li> <li>Build and maintain evaluation frameworks to measure agent reliability, accuracy, and performance in production-critical contexts</li> <li>Collaborate with cross-functional teams (firmware, UI, product) to identify high-impact opportunities for AI-driven automation and intelligent tooling</li> <li>Stay at the forefront of agentic AI research — including LLM orchestration, RAG, function calling, and autonomous code generation — and bring those advances into our platform</li> <li>Mentor engineers across the team on AI-first development practices and help establish best practices for human-agent collaboration</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>What experience would help someone be successful in the role at Roku?</strong>&nbsp;</h3> <ul> <li>Proven experience building agentic AI systems that generate, optimize, and deliver scalable applications in production environments</li> <li>Strong software engineering foundation with a track record of shipping reliable, performant systems at scale</li> <li>Deep familiarity with modern LLM orchestration tools, prompt engineering techniques, and AI/ML frameworks</li> <li>Experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), function/tool calling, and evaluation-driven development for AI agents</li> <li>A builder's mentality — you don't just use AI tools, you create autonomous systems that multiply the impact of entire teams</li> <li>Proficiency in TypeScript (or similar languages) and Python for agent development, scripting, and pipeline automation</li> <li>A software engineer's instinct for reliability, testability, and clean architecture — applied to the unique challenges of non-deterministic AI systems</li> <li>Excellent technical communication, root cause analysis abilities, and a proactive mindset with passion for fast iteration</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h6>#LI-NM1</h6> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong><span style="font-family: GothamBold, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;">What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?</span></strong></h3> <p>Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>What are some of the benefits?</strong></h3> <p>Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>Accommodations</strong></h3> <p>Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to <a ---------- <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>What should I know about Roku's culture?</strong></h3> <p>Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. </p> <p>We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002. </p> <p>To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit <a href="https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet">https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet</a>.</p> <p>By providing your information, you acknowledge that you want Roku to contact you about job roles, that you have read Roku's <a href="https://www.weareroku.com/roku-job-applicant-privacy-notice-for-job-applicants">Applicant Privacy Notice</a>, and understand that Roku will use your information as described in that notice. If you do not wish to receive any communications from Roku regarding this role or similar roles in the future, you may unsubscribe at any time by emailing <a ----- ----- Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>At Poka, we're changing how the world's industrial teams work — capturing the knowledge of their best people and putting it in every operator's hands.</strong></p> <p><strong>Our connected worker platform is purpose-built for manufacturing and the wider industrial world, with industrial AI inside the shift, not on top of it. The result: frontline performance that becomes compounding knowledge and measurable impact — every shift, every site, every region.</strong></p> <p><strong>We're proud to support global leaders like Nestlé, Bosch, Mars, and Danone across 3,000+ sites in 70+ countries. And as a fast-growing part of the IFS family, you'll join a team whose daily work directly shapes the platform behind how modern manufacturing gets done.</strong></p> <hr> <p>&nbsp;</p></div><div> <p>Most enterprise SaaS gets sold to people in offices. You'll be selling something that lives on the factory floor, across a continent of different markets, languages, and ways of working. You'll need to be as credible with a plant manager in Southampton as with a CIO in Munich.</p> <h3><strong>Role overview</strong></h3> <p>As an Enterprise Account Executive, you'll bring Poka to some of Europe's best-known manufacturers. You'll help them solve real operational problems, move their digital transformation forward, and show measurable impact across their frontline operations.</p> <p>You'll own new business from the first conversation to signature. That means finding the right accounts, running discovery that gets to the heart of how a plant actually works, and building business cases that both operations and finance believe in. It also means closing multi-site, often multi-country deals with many stakeholders. You'll work alongside Sales Development, Solutions Consulting, Customer Success and our IFS partners, and you'll have a real say in how Poka grows its European business.</p> <p>This is a high-impact role for someone who pairs sharp commercial instincts with a real understanding of manufacturing and of how European enterprises buy software.</p> <h3><strong>What you'll be doing</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Find and develop new business across your European territory through market research, outbound prospecting and close work with the Sales Development team</li> <li>Own the full sales cycle: discovery and needs analysis, product demos, proposals, negotiation and close</li> <li>Build tailored business cases that tie Poka's platform to each prospect's operational priorities and show clear value</li> <li>Handle cross-border deals where group-level decisions have to work for local sites, works councils and regional IT</li> <li>Partner closely with Customer Success and other teams so customers move smoothly from signature to long-term value</li> <li>Keep opportunities, forecasts and account activity accurate and up to date in Salesforce</li> <li>Put AI to work in your day-to-day, from research and account planning to conversation intelligence, drafting and CRM copilots, so you sell smarter and spend more time with customers</li> <li>Bring customer insights and market feedback to leadership to help shape go-to-market strategy and product direction</li> <li>Represent Poka at trade shows, industry events and virtual conferences across Europe</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What you bring</strong></h3> <ul> <li>5+ years of new business experience, in B2B sales or a similar Account Executive role</li> <li>Proven experience selling SaaS, ideally into manufacturing, industrial technology or digital transformation&nbsp;</li> <li>Confidence leading complex sales conversations with many stakeholders, from the plant floor to the C-suite</li> <li>Experience selling across more than one European market, and an understanding of how buying differs between them</li> <li>Strong negotiation, relationship-building and problem-solving skills</li> <li>A results-driven mindset and a track record of meeting or beating sales targets</li> <li>A hands-on, curious approach to AI and modern sales tools. You already use them to work smarter and want to keep learning</li> <li>Fluent written and spoken English, with strong presentation skills (another language, such as German or French, is an advantage)</li> <li>Based in the UK or Ireland and willing to travel up to 40%</li> </ul> <p>We know great sellers come from varied paths. If you don't tick every box but you've consistently landed complex new business and can quickly earn the trust of operations leaders, we'd love to hear from you.</p> <h3><strong>Why Poka</strong></h3> <p>Manufacturers are under pressure on three fronts:</p> <ul> <li>capturing what a retiring workforce knows</li> <li>getting new people productive faster</li> <li>getting AI onto the floor in a way operators actually use</li> </ul> <p>Poka is one of very few platforms that does all three, and it's already trusted at 3,000+ sites. Many of the world's biggest manufacturers are headquartered in Europe, so you'll be selling close to where the big decisions get made. You'll have the reach of IFS behind you and the pace and ownership of a growth-stage company.</p> </div> <p><span style="font-weight: 400; color: #ffffff;">#LI-TK</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><div> <p data-ghq-card-content-type="paragraph"><strong>What we offer:</strong></p> <ul> <li><span data-ghq-card-content-type="paragraph">Generous vacation policy</span>, additional paid days, and charity day.</li> <li>Scale-up energy with huge backing and a global yet close-knit team.</li> <li>A truly flexible schedule and remote-friendly working - including up to 8 weeks a year working from abroad.</li> <li>Wellbeing support from day one, including free 1:1 sessions with certified coaches and therapists.</li> <li>MacBook Pro, plus home-office and monthly allowances to set you up properly.</li> <li>An annual learning and development budget to keep your career moving.</li> <li>Regular team meetups and industry events - remote never means disconnected.</li> <li>A rewarding employee referral program for successful hires.</li> </ul> <p><em>Exact benefits vary by country - we'll walk you through your full local package during the hiring process.</em></p> </div> <p><em>Want to learn more about our culture? In this role, you will own complex lease administration activities, maintain lease data integrity, support ASC 842 / IFRS 16 and SOX compliance, and improve reporting and controls within our lease management system, CoStar.</p> <p>You’ll partner closely with Accounting, Finance, Operations, Tax, Legal, and external landlords and brokers to ensure lease obligations are accurately captured, payments are processed appropriately, and critical dates and contractual requirements are effectively managed. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys interpreting complex agreements, solving problems, and improving processes in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.</p> <h2><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own lease abstraction and interpretation for complex and non-standard data center, real estate, and equipment leases.</li> <li>Review and approve lease abstractions and data entry completed by Lease Analysts and third-party providers, providing quality-control sign-off.</li> <li>Manage critical lease dates, including renewals, terminations, escalations, and notice deadlines.</li> <li>Coordinate with Accounts Payable and DC leadership to ensure timely and accurate lease payments and approvals.</li> <li>Partner with landlords and brokers to resolve billing disputes, reconcile CAM, operating expenses, and tax charges, and confirm lease commencement and rent commencement dates.</li> <li>Perform desk audits of annual operating expense statements to validate charges against lease terms.</li> <li>Interpret complex commercial lease provisions related to rent, taxes, insurance, power usage, cross-connects, and other contractual obligations.</li> <li>Support lease negotiations, amendments, and legal redlines by providing lease administration expertise and historical context.</li> <li>Maintain accurate lease data in CoStar, identify data quality issues, and implement improvements to strengthen controls and reporting.</li> <li>Support ASC 842, IFRS 16, and SOX compliance, including internal and external audit requests, documentation, and data validation.</li> <li>Prepare and distribute recurring and ad hoc reports, KPI dashboards, critical-date trackers, and briefing materials for internal stakeholders and leadership.</li> <li>Serve as a primary point of contact for landlord and broker relationships, including escalations and issue resolution.</li> <li>Build strong relationships with Accounting, Finance, Operations, Tax, and Legal to ensure timely and accurate lease information.</li> <li>Train, mentor, and provide quality oversight for Lease Analysts.</li> <li>Drive continuous improvement across lease administration workflows, reporting, controls, and system utilization.</li> <li>Serve as backup to the Lease Administration Manager during absences, including approvals, escalations, and time-sensitive decisions.</li> <li>Support Tax with VAT recovery activities as needed by region.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who You Are</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Real Estate, or a related field.</li> <li>5+ years of commercial real estate lease administration experience, preferably supporting data centers or other complex effectively across Finance, Accounting, Operations, Legal, and external partners.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with CoStar or a similar lease administration platform.</li> <li>Experience with Asana and Google Workspace.</li> <li>Familiarity with SOX controls and IFRS 16.</li> <li>Data center or infrastructure-related lease administration experience.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Wondering if you’re a good fit? If some of this describes you, we’d love to talk.</strong></p> <ul> <li>You possess excellent communication, organisational, and analytical skills.</li> <li>You are able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.</li> <li>You have a proactive mindset with a track record of identifying gaps and driving solutions.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Why CoreWeave?</strong></h2> <p>At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Be Curious at Your Core</strong></li> <li><strong>Act Like an Owner</strong></li> <li><strong>Empower Employees</strong></li> <li><strong>Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences</strong></li> <li><strong>Achieve More Together</strong></li> </ul> <p>We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. training, fine-tuning, inference and applied-intelligence requirements.</li> <li>Engage founders, CTOs, researchers and investors before infrastructure architectures and platform relationships are firmly established.</li> <li>Create qualified opportunities and introductions for country Startup and Digital Native field teams, connecting high-potential companies rapidly to the right sellers, ownership.</li> <li>Coordinate strategically important opportunities across Sales, Field Engineering, Product, Engineering, Capacity, Finance, Legal, Marketing and Customer Success.</li> <li>Establish transformation points of view.</li> <li>Define the Enterprise AI Learning Loop narrative and articulate how CoreWeave becomes the ways and means through which customers operate and scale those loops.</li> <li>Build the initial Enterprise sales plays, executive narratives, sales content and pitch materials required by field teams.</li> <li>Develop and launch a repeatable Enterprise adoption methodology covering evaluation, production deployment, expansion and scaled adoption.</li> <li>Define the engagement model for Forward Deployed Engineers, Field Engineering and services within
